user_request_summary: Evaluate and improve SRS for local Markdown imports where linked documents must also be saved into the knowledge store, while preventing infinite loops and duplicate saves.

subagent_findings.summary: Existing SRS covers SQLite ledger, source scanning, link graph, and single-document save_document, but does not require source-path-backed local linked Markdown ingestion. Recommended FR-DOC-029 and updates around source identity.

subagent_findings.focus: Existing link parser and traversal behavior
subagent_findings.summary: src/main/link-parser.js already extracts Markdown links and wikilinks, skips protocols/anchors/images, and prevents viewer traversal loops with visited/globalSeen/depth/file caps. Import still needs graph-oriented persistence, source-to-destination mapping, structured diagnostics, and E2E fixtures.

Raw absolute path should not be the primary identity. Recommended stable documentId, source_id/path_key for duplicate/update lookup, root_fingerprint/source-relative path for source identity, canonical realpath hash for traversal visited sets, and content_hash for no-op/stale/move-copy decisions.

Recursive linked import belongs in Settings/local import workflow backed by an internal importer/scanner service, not in content-only MCP save_document and not as a silent viewer open side effect. smart_search should consume stored graph data and remain read-only.

Active SRS trace cleanup is clean, but linked local Markdown import was a requirements gap and knowledge.md still had stale 7-tool references. Recommended adding dedicated DOC requirements and updating research to active 8-tool save/search contract.

decisions.decision: Linked local Markdown import is a bounded Settings/local import workflow, not an MCP save_document extension.
decisions.reason: IR-MCP-018 and FR-DOC-028 intentionally keep save_document content-only, no-viewer, and free of caller path/import/indexing-control fields.

decisions.decision: Import follows linked documents of linked documents, but only within bounded depth/file/byte/cancel limits.
decisions.reason: This preserves graph connectivity without becoming an unbounded crawler.

decisions.decision: Infinite-loop prevention uses canonical source identity visited sets and records skipped cycle/limit edge diagnostics.
decisions.reason: Viewer link tree already proves the local pattern; importer needs persistent graph semantics rather than tree-only behavior.

decisions.decision: Already imported documents are not saved again.
decisions.reason: Duplicate detection uses stable documentId, source_id/path_key, root_fingerprint, canonical path hash, and content_hash according to separate roles.
They are required for containment and duplicate checks but must not be returned in MCP/search/log/export surfaces under SEC-DOC-003.

FR-DOC-029.purpose: Local linked Markdown import preserves graph connectivity without duplicate saves.

DR-DOC-011.purpose: Local source identity ledger prevents duplicate linked-document imports.

index_updates: 0.11.0-w2 goal now includes bounded local linked-Markdown import
research_updates: Replaced stale 7-tool smart_search-only wording with typed 8-tool save_document + smart_search contract.
Added local linked Markdown import policy, identity model, import graph tables, and no-MCP-import-control boundary.
trace_cleanup: OPS-ARCH-009 package smoke traces now acknowledge existing smoke:package, better-sqlite3 native rebuild, asarUnpack, and Wave 1.5 package smoke tests.
DR-DOC-006 package trace now acknowledges existing better-sqlite3 dependency and native packaging hooks.

recommended_tests: test/fixtures/import-link-closure with A.md -> B.md -> C.md -> A.md, self-link, duplicate links, duplicate basename, already imported B.md, missing target, outside-root target, symlink/junction escape, URL-encoded spaces, and Korean filenames.
Importer E2E verifies one saved document per canonical source identity, preserved or rewritten relative links, structured counts, and resolved/missing edge states.
Search E2E verifies imported linked documents are retrievable through search_documents and smart_search after indexing completion or keyword-only degraded indexing.
